/demo/scenarios/.title: Register a new customer
/demo/scenarios/.explain: A signup event arrives and the welcome-email workflow reacts.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: A welcome email appears in the demo mailbox. No real email is sent.

/demo/scenarios/.title: Place an order
/demo/scenarios/.explain: One order event fans out to two workflows: an internal notification and an n8n hand-off.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: A team notification appears, and the n8n adapter records a simulated call.

/demo/scenarios/.title: Stock drops below the reorder level
/demo/scenarios/.explain: The rule compares quantity with reorder_level.

/demo/scenarios/.title: Stock update that needs no action
/demo/scenarios/.explain: Quantity is above the reorder level, so the condition does not match.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The execution is marked Skipped, with the reason in its log. No alert is created.

/demo/scenarios/.title: Urgent support request
/demo/scenarios/.explain: Routing rules are checked in order and the first match wins.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The ticket is assigned to Escalations (rule 1).

/demo/scenarios/.title: Billing support request
/demo/scenarios/.explain: Not urgent, so rule 1 is skipped and the billing rule matches.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The ticket is assigned to the Billing team (rule 2).

/demo/scenarios/.title: Welcome email that bounces
/demo/scenarios/.explain: The simulated mail server permanently rejects bounce.example.com addresses.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The execution fails with a clear message and an error notification is created automatically.

/demo/scenarios/.title: Welcome email with a temporary failure
/demo/scenarios/.explain: The simulated mail server times out on the first attempt only.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The first attempt fails. Open it in Executions and press Retry: attempt 2 succeeds.

/demo/scenarios/.title: The same event delivered twice
/demo/scenarios/.explain: Senders often deliver webhooks more than once. Both deliveries carry the same event ID.
/demo/scenarios/.expect: The second delivery is recognised as a duplicate and creates no new executions.
